quote: In his memoir "Sur les équations fonctionnelles" (Parts I-III, 1919-1920), Fatou expressed that it was probable that the property of hyperbolicity belongs to generic rational maps
note: The conjecture originated in Fatou's 1919-1920 memoir on functional equations where he suggested (though not formally) that hyperbolicity should hold generically. The conjecture was later formalized as a rigorous problem by Stephen Smale in the 1960s. We report the earliest occurrence in 1919.
